activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Meaningful changes to this project: who changed what, and when.
activity.empty: Changes to requirements, documents, tasks, memory and decisions will appear here.

types.model_fallback_used: {title} was unavailable; a fallback model answered.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: What the product must do, where each item came from and how sure we are.

placeholders.title: Customer can export invoices as PDF
placeholders.description: Invoices are exported from the billing page with the company logo and tax number.

requirements.empty: No requirements yet. Complete the interview or add one yourself.

sync.title: Requirements, PRD, plan and tasks from your repository
sync.body: Read the repository documents again. Requirements the project does not have yet are added, and the repository's PRD, plan and task list are used where the project has none of its own. Anything you edited is kept, and everything added is marked as imported until you confirm it.
sync.aiHint: Helps when the documents are written as paragraphs instead of lists. The documents are sent to your configured AI model, and only items it can quote from the text are kept.
sync.nothingNew: Nothing new: every requirement in the documents is already here.
sync.noDocs: This project has no repository documents to read.
sync.rateLimit: Too many requests. Try again later.
sync.failed: Could not update from the documents. Try again.

unavailable.no_model: No AI model is chosen yet. Ask the platform owner to pick a default model under AI & Models → Models.
unavailable.capability_missing: “{model}” is not marked as able to return structured answers (missing: {missing}). Ask the platform owner to enable it under AI & Models → Models.
unavailable.model_unavailable: “{model}” cannot be used right now: the model or its provider is disabled, or the provider connection failed its test. Check AI & Models.
unavailable.provider_failed: “{model}” did not answer ({code}). Check the provider key and the model id under AI & Models.

adopted.prd: The PRD now comes from the repository.
adopted.plan: The plan now comes from the repository.

kept.prd: Kept your PRD: it was edited, so the repository's version was not used.
kept.plan: Kept your plan: it was edited, so the repository's version was not used.

bulk.title: Actions on the selected requirements
bulk.selected: {count, plural, one {# requirement selected} other {# requirements selected}}
bulk.applied: {count, plural, one {# requirement updated} other {# requirements updated}}.
bulk.deleteBody: {count, plural, one {# requirement} other {# requirements}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
bulk.deleted: {count, plural, one {# requirement deleted} other {# requirements deleted}}.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Project documents in Markdown. Every save keeps a version.
documents.stale: Someone saved a newer version. Copy your changes, then reload to continue from the latest version.

prdAsk.title: Which document is the PRD?
prdAsk.body: The import read your docs folder but could not tell which file is the PRD. Pick it from the files found in the repository, or paste or upload it yourself. A repository file keeps following GitHub. If there is no PRD yet, leave this for now.
prdAsk.label: PRD file in the repository
prdAsk.none: No PRD in the repository? Nothing is generated: the PRD stays empty until you add one.
prdAsk.exists: This project already has a PRD.
prdAsk.fileSize: The file is too large (200 KB at most).

documents.prdDescription: The product requirements, generated from the interview. Review, edit and approve it.

hint.synced: This document matches the file in the repository.
hint.pending_pr: Changes are waiting in a pull request. They reach the repository once it is merged.
hint.conflict: Both Saqina and the repository changed this document. Open it to choose which version to keep.
hint.remote_missing: The file was removed in the repository. Open it to decide what to do.
hint.excluded: This document is not synced, for example because an import was truncated.

dialog.title: Resolve conflict
dialog.explain: Both sides changed {file} since the last sync, so Saqina cannot merge them by itself.
dialog.missingExplain: The file for {file} was removed in the repository. You can keep the Saqina version and recreate it.
dialog.diff: Changes if you use the repository version
dialog.keepSaqinaHint: Your text stays and is sent to the repository on the next sync.
dialog.keepSaqinaMissingHint: Your text stays and the file is recreated in the repository on the next sync.
dialog.useRepoHint: The repository text is saved as a new version here.

prdCheck.title: {count, plural, one {The PRD and the project disagree in 1 place} other {The PRD and the project disagree in # places}}
prdCheck.hint: Checked after every change. A finding closes by itself once it is fixed. Updating the PRD always goes through a proposal you approve.
prdCheck.proposalCreated: Proposal created. It waits for review in Approvals.
prdCheck.failed: Could not do that. Only requirements missing from the PRD can be proposed.

map.title: Document map ({count})
map.hint: What each repository document is for, found from its name, folder and text. Only changed files are read again.

diagram.label: Diagram
diagram.invalid: This diagram could not be drawn. Its source is shown instead.

signing.title: Approval and signatures

hint.team: Approve the text, then both parties sign the same version. The document is issued with its reference number once both have signed.
hint.client: Read the document. If you agree, sign it. If something needs to change, ask the team for a change.

signing.approveFirst: Approve the document first (the button under the text), then sign.
signing.editNote: Changing the text, or taking the approval back, removes the signatures so nobody signs words they did not see.
signing.shareFirst: The client signs what they can read. Share the approved document with them so they can sign.

prdGenerate.title: Generate PRD

source.prd: Filled from the current PRD. Change any section, or let Enhance make it more specific.
source.interview: Filled from the project interview. Change any section, or let Enhance make it more specific.
source.empty: Nothing to fill from yet. Write each section, or let Enhance start from what you type.

prdGenerate.newVersion: Saving creates a new PRD version. Signatures are cleared and the PRD needs approval again.
prdGenerate.byModel: Enhanced with {model}. Check it before saving.
prdGenerate.byRules: Tidied by rules (no AI model is set up).
prdGenerate.stale: Someone saved the PRD while you were editing. Open Generate PRD again to start from the new version.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Goal, milestones and the tasks inside them. Simple on purpose.

placeholders.title: Launch MVP
placeholders.goal: Customers can sign up, pay and use the core features.

plan.empty: No plan yet. It is created when the interview is complete.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Create, move and complete work. Changes save immediately.

placeholders.title: Add password reset flow
placeholders.description: Send a reset link by email and expire it after 30 minutes.

tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Add the first one or generate them from the interview.
tasks.failed: The change could not be saved and was undone.

agent.title: Agent
agent.assignHint: Pick who works on this task. Your click is the approval; the run starts right away.
agent.none: No agent in this project has the skills for this task.

reasons.busy: {count, plural, one {# active run} other {# active runs}}
reasons.notExecutable: Not connected yet: the run will fail honestly

agent.instructionsPlaceholder: Follow the existing form components and add tests

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Your project remembers what you decided. Agents read this before they work.

placeholders.title: Client prefers weekly updates on Friday
placeholders.content: Send a short summary by email every Friday afternoon. No calls unless urgent.

memory.empty: Nothing remembered yet. Important facts about architecture, product and preferences appear here.

graph.label: Memory map with {count} memories
graph.hidden: {count} older memories are not drawn. The list shows all of them.
graph.pick: Select a node to read the memory. The list view has the full text.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: Why something was chosen. Memory is what the project knows; decisions explain the choices.

placeholders.question: Which payment gateway do we use?
placeholders.context: Most customers pay with bank transfer and e-wallets.
placeholders.reason: Best local payment method coverage and simple integration.

decisions.empty: No decisions yet. Important architectural or product decisions will appear here as your project evolves.
decisions.selectedNotOption: The selected option must be one of the options.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Choose who builds. Every agent works from the same project context.
agents.foundation: Agent connections arrive in a later phase. Today you can choose a preferred agent and preview the context it will receive.
agents.configureHint: Pick the model and add notes. Never paste API keys or tokens here.

placeholders.notes: Prefer concise answers and avoid new dependencies

agents.secretRejected: That looks like a credential. Remove keys and tokens from the configuration.

context.title: Agent context
context.description: Exactly what Saqina Dev would hand to {agent}, assembled from this project's data.

agents.modelHint: Only models set up under AI & Models are listed. Automatic follows the project and platform defaults.
agents.modelHintExternal: This agent runs in its own tool; the choice is sent with each handoff as its preferred model.
agents.modelLocked: The platform policy does not let a project pin a model for its agents, so Automatic is used.
agents.modelNone: No model is set up yet. Ask the platform owner to add one under AI & Models.

studio.title: Studio
studio.prdNotApproved: The PRD is not approved yet. Agents work from it, so approve it first.
studio.planEmpty: No plan yet. Ask in the chat, for example "make a plan for the checkout", and it appears here.
studio.agentsHint: Saqina's agents work on the open tasks. Each result waits in Approvals before anything changes.
studio.agentsManual: This project is built outside Saqina, so agents do not start by themselves. Assign a task to an agent from the chat or the task list.

start.started: {count, plural, =0 {No open task was left to start.} one {# task was handed to an agent.} other {# tasks were handed to agents.}}
start.skipped: {count, plural, one {# task has no fitting agent and stays for the team.} other {# tasks have no fitting agent and stay for the team.}}

studio.noRepository: No repository is connected yet. Connect a GitHub repository and the Studio shows its code, branches, pull requests and checks.

errors.notConfigured: Saqina's Vercel account is not set up on this server. Use your own Vercel account instead.
errors.vercelBusy: Vercel is busy. Try again in a minute.
errors.vercelFailed: Vercel did not accept the request. Check that the Vercel GitHub app can see the repository.
errors.ownVercel: Custom domains need your own Vercel account.
errors.gitAuth: GitHub refused the repository token. Reconnect the repository under Integrations.
errors.gitNotFound: That path or repository was not found.
errors.gitFailed: GitHub could not be reached. Try again.
errors.previewNotReady: The app uses a database or sign-in service that is not ready to preview. Fill in the missing values under Databases and sign-in.
errors.exists: A service with that name already exists.
errors.unknown: That variable is not part of this service.
errors.encryptionUnavailable: Saqina cannot store keys yet: the encryption key is not set on this server.

code.hint: Read-only view of {repository} on its default branch.
code.truncated: Only the start of the file is shown.

git.eventsOff: Saqina is not listening to this repository yet. Turn on events to see pull requests, checks and deployments here, and to move tasks along.
git.installed: Events are on. Pull requests, checks and deployments now arrive in Saqina.
git.manual: Saqina could not add the webhook itself (the token needs admin rights on the repository). In GitHub, add a webhook with these values, content type JSON, for push, pull request, check suite, workflow run and deployment status events.
git.noLinks: No branch or pull request names a task yet. Use the task reference (for example T-1a2b3c4d) in the branch name or the pull request.

preview.none: Nothing is published yet. Publish the project and its latest version shows here.
preview.servicesBlocked: This app uses a database or sign-in service, and its preview is not ready yet. A preview needs its own database, separate from production:

lastError.vercelFailed: Vercel did not accept the request

publish.needsRepository: Connect a GitHub repository first: Vercel builds from it.
publish.published: Publishing started. The status appears below when Vercel reports it.

ownersHint.saqinaOff: Not set up on this server.
ownersHint.client: Uses your token and team; you can use your own domain.

publish.tokenHint: Create one in Vercel under Account Settings > Tokens. Stored encrypted, never shown again.
publish.tokenKept: A token is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
publish.teamHint: Leave empty for a personal account.
publish.domainHint: For example app.yourcompany.com. Point its DNS to Vercel as it explains.
publish.needsAccount: Saqina's Vercel is not set up on this server. Choose "My own Vercel" below, or ask the platform owner to set it up.
publish.servicesBlocked: Publishing waits until the preview databases and sign-in keys below are ready.

services.title: Databases and sign-in
services.intro: Use your own Neon, Supabase, Clerk or other account. Saqina does not provide a database: it keeps your keys encrypted for this project and sends them to the deployment. Keys are never shown again.
services.none: No database or sign-in service yet. An app that does not need one can be published as it is.
services.removeBody: Its stored keys are deleted from Saqina. The app may stop working until you add them again.
services.ready: Preview is ready: every service has its own preview values.
services.docs: How to make a preview branch
services.label: Name
services.customNamesHint: Separated by commas, for example DATABASE_URL, API_KEY. Letters, digits and underscores.

envHint.preview: Use a separate database or branch, and test keys for sign-in. Never the live ones.

services.kept: Already set. Leave empty to keep it.
services.saved: Saved. The keys are sent to the deployment on the next publish.

issues.missingProduction: {name} ({service}) has no value for the live site.
issues.missingPreview: {name} ({service}) has no value for the preview.
issues.previewSameAsProduction: {name} ({service}) is the same in preview and live. Use a separate database or branch for the preview.
issues.clerkLiveKeyInPreview: {name} ({service}) is a live Clerk key. Use a test key in the preview.
